Missile Mentor

-

Project created for the #BIGAJAMV2 sponsored by  BIGA Arcade

The  game theme is "Rivalry" and it must feature a "Companion".

Thinking on "Rivalry", I've created a game where you and your AI bot (trained by you) play against other AI bots (trained by other players). The game has a leaderboard based on player's Elo rating, updated after each battle.

Your "Companion", an AI bot, will learn to launch missiles by watching how you play, and will assist you launching missiles. Furthemore, your companion bot will battle alone against other real players + theirs companion bots, changing your ranking.

Therefore, the better you play, the better your AI pupil will be and your rank will go up.

Train hard, good luck and have fun!!!

.
